title: Nova Pulse 510 Thread Vape Battery
description:
The Nova Pulse takes innovation to the next level with a range of advanced features designed for a superior vaping experience. The standout feature is its larger LED screen, displaying real-time wattage settings ranging from 1.8V to 4.2V, giving users precise control over their vaping power.

The detachable silicone mouthpiece is not only comfortable but also washable, ensuring easy maintenance. Additionally, the device boasts an airflow control feature, a first in 510 batteries, allowing users to customize their draw resistance to perfection.

Specifications:

- Airflow Control: First 510 battery to offer this feature.

- Customizable Wattage: Fine-tune your vaping experience with wattage control from 1.8V to 4.2V.

- Spacious Compartment: Compatible with box carts, providing more flexibility.

- Battery Indicators: Stay informed with a battery percentage and puff counter display.

- Battery Capacity: 1000mAh for long-lasting performance.

- Charging Port: USB Type-C

Packaging Includes:

1 x Device
1 x Lanyard
1 x Manual
